First, note the date format is DD-MM-YYYY: 02-06-1283 means 2 June 1283.  
Subtract 41 days:  
June has 30 days, so go back to 22 May 1283 (2 June - 11 days = 22 May).  
Remaining days to subtract: 41 - 11 = 30 days.  
From 22 May, subtract 30 more days: April has 30 days in 1283 (leap year? 1283 not divisible by 4, so April has 30).  
22 May - 30 days = 23 April 1283.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1283-04-23
